{{Top|leg}}
'''Tatakoz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Master Trader]] from the [[Mospic High Range/Legends|Mospic High Range]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around the year [[96 BBY]]. He had been [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|cast out]] of his tribe and sold his goods from a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] with a [[repulsor trailer]]. Individuals in the [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] and [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] grew to appreciate Tatakoz's skill as a [[Merchant/Legends|trader]], which led several Jawa tribes to make an attempt to undercut his business. He eventually built and sold the first [[Monster droid/Legends|monster droid]].
